purpose: Map bounded Market requests to existing JANUS research organs without pretending that repository capability alone is a live public execution route.

JANUS.TOPA_HUNT.role: provenance-bound anomaly investigation, archive hunt, competing-hypothesis falsification and unresolved-case research
JANUS.TOPA_HUNT.required_bridge: MARKET -> HOME/Activator -> TOPA -> HOME receipt -> Market reconcile

JANUS.DEMIURGE_SCOUT.role: bounded 17-agent Scout Swarm reconnaissance across the JANUS repository constellation
JANUS.DEMIURGE_SCOUT.required_bridge: MARKET -> HOME/Activator -> Demiurge bounded scout dispatch -> receipt aggregation -> Market reconcile

JANUS.COUSTEAU_SCAN.role: ocean/seafloor bathymetry, multibeam, sidescan, hydroacoustic and instrument-control search/falsification
JANUS.COUSTEAU_SCAN.required_bridge: MARKET -> HOME/Activator -> Cousteau data-bound scan -> provenance receipt -> Market reconcile

JANUS.META_REGISTRY_SEARCH.role: JANUS registry/provenance discovery and durable research-memory pointer search
JANUS.META_REGISTRY_SEARCH.required_bridge: MARKET -> HOME/Activator -> registry read-only discovery -> receipt -> Market reconcile

JANUS.FUNDAMENTUM_AUDIT.role: formal-claim/source/proof-carrying research audit under fail-closed theorem authority
JANUS.FUNDAMENTUM_AUDIT.required_bridge: MARKET -> HOME/Activator -> bounded Fundamentum audit -> proof/source receipt -> Market reconcile

JANUS.SWARM_RESEARCH.role: bounded parallel multi-agent research attack with independence/provenance separation
JANUS.SWARM_RESEARCH.required_bridge: MARKET -> HOME/Activator -> bounded swarm manifest -> receipt aggregation -> Market reconcile

JANUS.FRESCO_FORGE.role: content-addressed canonical JSON-to-monumental-fresco visualization with semantic projection, visual anti-collapse gates and per-image provenance receipt
JANUS.FRESCO_FORGE.required_bridge: MARKET -> HOME/Activator -> isolated Fresco Forge input staging -> v5.4 render/gate -> provenance receipt -> HOME -> Market reconcile

JANUS.AGENT_EVAL.role: deterministic privacy-minimized trace/authority/provenance audit for AI-agent runs
JANUS.AGENT_EVAL.required_bridge: MARKET trace intake -> deterministic Agent Eval -> immutable result hash -> Market reconcile

supporting_organs.Hawkar-usls/Hrain: memory/context support; memory is not evidence or command authority
supporting_organs.Hawkar-usls/Demi_Head: execution/source receipt and proposal gate; not truth authority
supporting_organs.Hawkar-usls/aura-oracle-tg: candidate discrimination/precommitment only; oracle output is not evidence
supporting_organs.Hawkar-usls/janus-lapis: candidate-generation/research support only until domain-specific validation
